claims: Two agents: shopping agent (lives in your app: search catalog, compare, build cart, answer order/policy questions, remembers preferences) and merchant agent (listings, pricing, campaigns, inventory flags), all actions staged for human approval
Core insight: every customer question is demand data; out-of-stock requests and price comparisons flow to the merchant agent as restock/price/promo signals in real time
Anthropic page claim: carts up to 35% larger, 60% more likely to complete purchase
README: everything (ACME) is fictional; payment is left to your existing checkout or agentic payments provider; verticals run on ports 3000-3003 (retail, travel, etc.)
how_to_steps: pip install requirements, set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env, run the demos (`python scripts/run_demo.py` style; four verticals on ports 3000-3003)
Shopping agent integrates at catalog, cart, checkout, customer preferences, order history
Merchant agent answers sales questions, tracks inventory, recommends pricing, drafts campaigns; human approves before changes
Use the Claude plugin / commerce-builder plugin in the repo to scaffold for your own store
on_screen_only: GitHub README text: 'Two commerce agents built on Claude: a shopping agent a business embeds in its app for customers, and a merchant agent its staff use to run the back office. Each is defined once (prompt, skills, tool contracts, gates) and runs on the Messages API, the Claude Agent SDK, and Managed Agents; four runnable verticals show both over the same libraries.'

Note: 'Every company, brand, product, and person here is fictional; the only company is ACME. Nothing places an order, charges a card, or changes a live listing... Business rules, authorization, and compliance are the deployment's.'

Diagrams: 'Customer question (out of stock or price check) -> Shopping agent logs every interaction -> demand signal -> merchant agent'; 'Customer signals: Restock signal / Price signal / Promo signal -> business acts today'
Anthropic site card 'Building commerce agents with Claude'
Repo owner visible as 'anthropics' in file list header; 4-day-old commits 'building commerce agents using claude'
